Name: Nergal-sharezer
Summary: Nergal-sharezer was a prince of the king of Babylon who sat in the middle gate of Jerusalem when the city fell, and later — called Rab-mag — was among those sent to release Jeremiah from prison.
KeyStory: When Jerusalem was taken, the princes of Babylon, including Nergal-sharezer, sat in the middle gate, and Nergal-sharezer later helped send for Jeremiah's release.
LifeLesson: The fall of a city is carried out by named men, not by faceless forces.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
